alexa-sec: Urgent advisory: coordinated disclosure received for a SAML metadata parsing issue in the SAML helper library (CVE-2026-2765). This can trigger out-of-band XML entity expansion and remote metadata fetch when IdP metadata auto-import is enabled.

alexa-sec: Scope: Affects Redwood Private customers that enabled `saml.auto_import=true` and older Dedicated clusters that still run the metadata-sync cron job. Hosted API (managed auth) is not impacted.

rui: Roughly how many installs? Need to notify Customer Success asap.

alexa-sec: Inventory shows 9 Dedicated tenants + 5 Private customers with auto-import enabled. I'm attaching the customer list to REQ-8032.

omar-sre: Short mitigation plan: 1) Immediately disable auto-import by flipping `saml.auto_import=false`, 2) Deploy patched library (v2.4.7-p2) to images, 3) Force rotation of any federated certs ingested in the past 45 days.

deploy-bot: Patch images built: `redwood/saml-helper:2.4.7-p2` and `redwood/saml-helper:2.4.7-p2-onprem`. CI/CD pipeline queued for canary.

tara-cs: I'll draft a customer advisory. We need a clear opt-in for us to apply the fix and an opt-out if they prefer manual steps.

mike-privacy: For regulated customers, include assurance that no user credentials were exposed and reference our audit logs for metadata fetch events. Legal review required.

alexa-sec: Timeline: emergency mitigate (disable) within 2 hours; canary rollout to Dedicated within 8 hours; full rollout 36 hours. Certificate rotation window: 72 hours for affected customers.

omar-sre: Disable commands: Dedicated control plane (kubectl):

omar-sre: ```bash
kubectl -n redwood-system patch configmap saml-settings -p '{"data":{"auto_import":"false"}}'
```

omar-sre: For Helm on Private: `helm upgrade --set saml.autoImport=false redwood-private ./chart`

rui: Can we auto-disable via the management API for Dedicated tenants?

omar-sre: Yes. Script ready to run against the control plane: `scripts/disable-saml-import.sh --tenant <id>`; will start on the high-risk list first.

alexa-sec: Customer comms copy (internal):

alexa-sec: "Security notice: CVE-2026-2765 12 Redwood has published a patch for a SAML metadata parsing vulnerability affecting Private and some Dedicated deployments using metadata auto-import. We recommend disabling metadata auto-import immediately and applying the provided patch. If you would like Redwood to perform the update, reply with your account ID and preferred maintenance window."

tara-cs: I'll adapt and include the opt-out, legal contact, and SSO rotation guidance.

mike-privacy: Add instructions for exporting import timestamps and which certs to rotate.

omar-sre: Canary policy: 3% low-traffic pools -> monitor auth traces and entity fetch logs for 1 hour -> 20% -> 100%. Rollback uses previous image tag.

alexa-sec: Logging & detection: runbook updated at https://wiki.redwood-internal/runbooks/saml-metadata-cve-2765. Please run the telemetry query to search for `entityDescriptor` fetches to external hosts in the last 90 days.

deploy-bot: REQ-8032 updated with patch status and customer notification checklist.

rui: I'll coordinate with CS for customer outreach and schedule account calls for any who request assisted remediation.

alexa-sec: Follow-up: we'll produce an internal incident summary and a short postmortem within 7 days. If anyone finds evidence of exploitation, escalate immediately to the incident channel and tag me.

omar-sre: Doing the disable now on the top 4 highest-risk clusters. Will post updates.

tara-cs: Noted, starting customer email thread template now.

alexa-sec: Thanks all. Stay on standby for legal/regulated customer approvals. :shield:
